title: Great Bridge of Hrazdan (Kievyan Bridge)
visualBrief: Compact Kievyan paired-vault bridge with basalt transverse portals, approach access arches, deck and recognizable rosette railings. Original detailed master independently preserved.

nativeAxes.y: up from reconstructed arch-foot foundation level

sourceFacts.construction: Reinforced concrete with cast-iron handrails; city tourism inventory.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original3082666-triangle/272015896-byte master reproduced exactly; independent31722-triangle medium-fi source simplifies masonry, hardware and panels.

reconstruction.archSpanStatus: Photo-scaled reconstruction; repeated unsourced115m captions are not treated as engineering measurements.
reconstruction.notes: Mapped exposed structure is retained separately from differing owner totals which include approaches. Paired vault widths, five spandrel posts per half, portal dimensions and vertical position are photographic reconstructions. Stable existing deck state is represented; current repairs do not prove completion.

geographicProposal.notes: One inspected river-level picture confirms the paired broad concrete vaults, open spandrel posts and stone-faced portal supports. Standard viewer PMTiles named Kievyan road confirms northeast axis and retained272.304m exposed outline; differing351/364m owner totals include longer approaches and are not used to stretch this source. Western road1029.9605m at native[-150,0] gives approximatebase971.6605m against modelroad58.3m. The opposite road sample differs11m in coarse gorge terrain. Retain the authored level deck and photo-based115m arch; exact vertical curve/bank joins remain uncertain. Narrow live ground opening and a16m preview contact corridor blended to raw by60m remove coarse bridge terrain imprint. This is approximate exterior visualization, not a gorge or foundation survey.

Compact source uses shared basalt/concrete/painted metal; individual masonry joints, cast tooling, cap edges, deck girders and maintenance rails are simplified. Skyline merges the paired vaults; street/closeup restore both vaults and rosette impressions. Physical-device timings remain unmeasured.
importReason: Preserve thin cables, rail frames and hardware across the full crossing; whole-object quantization loses these details.
